notes: §1985:XI.4.1.3 SR5: 'File-name-2, file-name-3, and file-name-4 must be described in a file description entry, not in a sort-merge description entry, in the Data Division.' BindMerge maps the USING and GIVING lists through SortMapIoFiles, which resolves each name through StatementValidation.ResolveFile and refuses a file whose model IsSortMerge with COBOL1757, at every edition including 85. The report-file exclusion 2023 adds also holds at 85, by §1985:XIII.3.3.3 SR3 (a report file 'may be referenced in the Procedure Division only by the USE statement, the CLOSE statement, or the OPEN statement'), through ScreenReportFileReference (COBOL2577). Probes at --std 85: (b) another SD as file-name-3 (USING IN1 SW2), as file-name-4 (GIVING SW2, and GIVING OUT1 SW2 as the second GIVING file), and the MERGE's own SD in USING and in GIVING: each COBOL1757; a SELECT with no FD in USING: COBOL2635; a report FD in GIVING: COBOL2577; (e) GIVING an indexed and a relative file together compiles and both hold AAAA BBBB CCCC on read-back. The witness names an SD as file-name-3.

next.reason: 1985: "must be described in a file description entry, not in a sort-merge description entry"; 2023: "shall be described in a file description entry that is not for a report file and is not a sort-merge file description entry". 2023 also excludes report files as USING/GIVING files. The 1985 rule refuses only sort-merge entries, so 2023 refuses programs this rule alone accepts.
